# Generated by tools/syzlang_gen.py from the measured
# inventories. Do not edit by hand: regenerate, or the next run overwrites the
# correction. Driver 610.57.04, checkout e4a5faa2.
#
# Request numbers are literal here because the syzkaller tree carrying
# syz-extract is absent from this repository, so a .const file could not be
# produced against a format this tool can check. nvidia_gspwn.h holds
# the same numbers as _IOWR macros for syz-extract to consume on the SUT.


# Device nodes. /dev/nvidia-modeset is in scope:
# libnvidia-container creates it by default (src/nvc.c:317) and
# withholds it only under OPT_NO_MODESET. Both DRM nodes are in
# scope on the CDI path, which adds every /dev/dri node found for
# the GPU's PCI bus id with no capability check
# (nvidia-container-toolkit internal/platform-support/dgpu/
# nvml.go:48-55). The card node and the render node are separate
# resources because drm_ioctl_permit refuses a render client any
# command whose flag word omits DRM_RENDER_ALLOW.
resource fd_nv[fd]
resource fd_nvidiactl[fd_nv]
resource fd_nvidia[fd_nv]
resource fd_nvidia_uvm[fd]
resource fd_nvidia_uvm_tools[fd]
resource fd_nvidia_modeset[fd]
resource fd_nvidia_uvm_vaspace[fd_nvidia_uvm]
resource fd_dri[fd]
resource fd_dri_card[fd_dri]
resource fd_dri_render[fd_dri]

openat$nvidiactl(fd const[0xffffffffffffff9c], file ptr[in, string["/dev/nvidiactl"]], flags const[0x2], mode const[0]) fd_nvidiactl
openat$nvidia(fd const[0xffffffffffffff9c], file ptr[in, string["/dev/nvidia#"]], flags const[0x2], mode const[0]) fd_nvidia
openat$nvidia_uvm(fd const[0xffffffffffffff9c], file ptr[in, string["/dev/nvidia-uvm"]], flags const[0x2], mode const[0]) fd_nvidia_uvm
openat$nvidia_uvm_tools(fd const[0xffffffffffffff9c], file ptr[in, string["/dev/nvidia-uvm-tools"]], flags const[0x2], mode const[0]) fd_nvidia_uvm_tools
openat$nvidia_modeset(fd const[0xffffffffffffff9c], file ptr[in, string["/dev/nvidia-modeset"]], flags const[0x2], mode const[0]) fd_nvidia_modeset
openat$dri_card(fd const[0xffffffffffffff9c], file ptr[in, string["/dev/dri/card#"]], flags const[0x2], mode const[0]) fd_dri_card
openat$dri_render(fd const[0xffffffffffffff9c], file ptr[in, string["/dev/dri/renderD#"]], flags const[0x2], mode const[0]) fd_dri_render

# The initialised UVM descriptor. 36 of the 39 uvm commands and
# uvm_mmap refuse a descriptor that has not been through
# uvm_api_initialize (kernel-open/nvidia-uvm/uvm.c:927), which sets
# UVM_FD_VA_SPACE at uvm.c:959. The producer is a pseudo-syscall and
# not ioctl$UVM_INITIALIZE: __UVM_ROUTE_CMD_STACK at
# kernel-open/nvidia-uvm/uvm_api.h:45 returns 0 on success and on
# failure alike, carrying the real status in params.rmStatus, and
# syzkaller takes a resource's value from the raw syscall return.
# A resource produced by that ioctl would hold 0 on every execution
# and every consumer would receive file descriptor 0.
#
# The implementation opens /dev/nvidia-uvm, issues UVM_INITIALIZE,
# and returns the descriptor. It lives in a patch this repository
# carries against the pinned syzkaller checkout; the declaration
# alone compiles, because pkg/compiler/consts.go:250 assigns no
# syscall number to a call whose name starts with syz_.
syz_nvidia_uvm_init(flags flags[uvm_init_flags]) fd_nvidia_uvm_vaspace

# family is worse than a bare integer, so the audit is the only
# route from a derived family to a set below.

# The re-entrant NV_ESC_IOCTL_XFER_CMD path. nv.c:2499 unwraps the
# wrapper once and re-enters the same dispatch switch with the three
# fields of nv_ioctl_xfer_t, so each variant pins the inner command
# to one escape number, sets the size to that escape's measured
# argument size and points the inner pointer at its parameter
# struct. The two multiplexers are absent: a wrapper naming either
# would leave its inner command or class field free.
ioctl$NV_ESC_IOCTL_XFER_CMD_RM_ALLOC_MEMORY(fd fd_nvidia, cmd const[0xc01046d3], arg ptr[inout, nv_xfer_rm_alloc_memory])

# Object allocation. hClass is pinned per class, hObjectParent takes
# the legal parent's handle, and hObjectNew produces the class's own
# resource, which chains one allocation to the next. A class whose
# legal parents all coexist on one chip carries one call per parent,
# named <class>_UNDER_<parent> after the first. A class whose parent
# set is chip-gated carries one call taking nv_handle, because at
# most one of those parents exists on any given GPU.
ioctl$NV_ESC_RM_ALLOC_ACCESS_COUNTER_NOTIFY_BUFFER(fd fd_nv, cmd const[0xc030462b], arg ptr[inout, nvos64_alloc_access_counter_notify_buffer])

# Entry points other than ioctl: ten calls over six of the seven
# nodes opened above, from four file_operations tables. nvidia_fops
# at kernel-open/nvidia/nv.c:250 registers poll and mmap and serves
# both /dev/nvidiactl and /dev/nvidiaN, uvm_fops at
# kernel-open/nvidia-uvm/uvm.c:1070 registers mmap, uvm_tools_fops
# at kernel-open/nvidia-uvm/uvm_tools.c:2744 registers poll, and
# nv_drm_fops registers both on both DRM nodes, which is four of the
# ten. /dev/nvidia-modeset is the seventh node: nvkms_fops registers
# an mmap and a poll that no description models.
# surface/entry-points.json carries the whole census, including the
# six tables no description opens. An entry point carries no method
# id, no parameter struct and no inventory row, so none of these
# calls is a command and none enters the command denominator.
nv_mmap_prot = 0x1, 0x2, 0x4
nv_mmap_flags = 0x1, 0x2, 0x10, 0x20
nv_poll_events = 0x1, 0x2, 0x4, 0x8, 0x10, 0x20

nv_pollfd_nvidiactl {
	fd	fd_nvidiactl
	events	flags[nv_poll_events, int16]
	revents	const[0, int16]
}

nv_pollfd_nvidia {
	fd	fd_nvidia
	events	flags[nv_poll_events, int16]
	revents	const[0, int16]
}

nv_pollfd_uvm_tools {
	fd	fd_nvidia_uvm_tools
	events	flags[nv_poll_events, int16]
	revents	const[0, int16]
}

nv_pollfd_dri_card {
	fd	fd_dri_card
	events	flags[nv_poll_events, int16]
	revents	const[0, int16]
}

nv_pollfd_dri_render {
	fd	fd_dri_render
	events	flags[nv_poll_events, int16]
	revents	const[0, int16]
}

# nvidia_mmap at kernel-open/nvidia/nv-mmap.c:770 reaches
# nvidia_mmap_helper, which consumes a mapping context a prior ioctl
# established. That helper abandons the mapping for any non-zero
# vm_pgoff at nv-mmap.c:554, so zero is the only offset that reaches
# the body and the offset is pinned to it.
mmap$nvidiactl(addr vma, len len[addr], prot flags[nv_mmap_prot], flags flags[nv_mmap_flags], fd fd_nvidiactl, offset const[0])
mmap$nvidia(addr vma, len len[addr], prot flags[nv_mmap_prot], flags flags[nv_mmap_flags], fd fd_nvidia, offset const[0])

# uvm_mmap at kernel-open/nvidia-uvm/uvm.c:759 returns -EBADFD at
# uvm.c:779 until a prior ioctl has made the descriptor a VA space,
# which is why this one takes the initialised subtype. Its offset is
# left free: uvm.c:793 requires vm_start == (vm_pgoff << PAGE_SHIFT),
# so the only legal offset is the mapping address the kernel selects
# at run time and no fixed value satisfies it. uvm.c:801 further
# requires VM_SHARED, VM_READ and VM_WRITE together, which one member
# of nv_mmap_flags and two of nv_mmap_prot give.
mmap$nvidia_uvm(addr vma, len len[addr], prot flags[nv_mmap_prot], flags flags[nv_mmap_flags], fd fd_nvidia_uvm_vaspace, offset intptr[0:0xffffffff, 0x1000])

# nvidia_poll at kernel-open/nvidia/nv.c:2280 and uvm_tools_poll at
# kernel-open/nvidia-uvm/uvm_tools.c:692. nvidia_fops serves both
# /dev/nvidiactl and /dev/nvidiaN, so both carry a poll call:
# nv.c:2292 branches on nv_is_control_device and skips the
# open-complete check that returns POLLERR for the actual device, so
# the control node is a reachable path of its own. uvm_fops
# registers no poll and uvm_tools_fops registers no mmap, so neither
# carries the other call.
poll$nvidiactl(fds ptr[in, array[nv_pollfd_nvidiactl]], nfds len[fds], timeout int32)
poll$nvidia(fds ptr[in, array[nv_pollfd_nvidia]], nfds len[fds], timeout int32)
poll$nvidia_uvm_tools(fds ptr[in, array[nv_pollfd_uvm_tools]], nfds len[fds], timeout int32)

# nv_drm_fops registers mmap and poll on both DRM nodes, so each
# node carries both calls. nv_drm_mmap at
# kernel-open/nvidia-drm/nvidia-drm-gem.c:250 looks the GEM object up
# by vm_pgoff through drm_vma_offset_exact_lookup_locked, so the only
# offset that reaches an object is the fake one a prior
# DRM_NVIDIA_GEM_MAP_OFFSET returned and no fixed value satisfies it.
# The poll side is the DRM core's own drm_poll.
mmap$dri_card(addr vma, len len[addr], prot flags[nv_mmap_prot], flags flags[nv_mmap_flags], fd fd_dri_card, offset intptr[0:0xffffffff, 0x1000])
mmap$dri_render(addr vma, len len[addr], prot flags[nv_mmap_prot], flags flags[nv_mmap_flags], fd fd_dri_render, offset intptr[0:0xffffffff, 0x1000])
poll$dri_card(fds ptr[in, array[nv_pollfd_dri_card]], nfds len[fds], timeout int32)
poll$dri_render(fds ptr[in, array[nv_pollfd_dri_render]], nfds len[fds], timeout int32)
